# lmw post show

Show a post and its most relevant comments

### Synopsis

Show a post and its most relevant comments.

POST is the post's address (copied from the browser) or URN.

```
lmw post show POST [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw post show https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678/
  lmw post show urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678 --comments 0
```

### Options

```
      --comments int   number of comments to show (0-50) (default 5)
      --full           show the complete post text
  -h, --help           help for show
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
